plan: Drive: from Town of Golden, about 23 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy E), Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy W), Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy).

Walk: none. The spot is at the road.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2021 cutblock (20 m N) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
